title: CiPA five-current cardiac ion channel panel
licence: Roster of publicly named ion channels. No third-party database content is redistributed here.
sourceNote: The five currents the CiPA in vitro ion-channel work stream nominates: IKr (hERG), peak and late INa (Nav1.5), ICaL (Cav1.2), IKs (KCNQ1/KCNE1) and IK1 (Kir2.1). Kir2.1 has no receptor preset in the loaded packs, so it is a declared coverage gap.
coverageNote: A docking score against a channel pore is not an electrophysiological current measurement. This panel exists to state which currents were NOT interrogated; it produces no proarrhythmia call, and there is no field in which to put one.

targets.name: Nav1.5 - INa peak and late sodium current
